reason: I already learn from free YouTube and TikTok clips every night, and tom yum, pad see ew and massaman have tons of free videos in Thai. Maybe I download it to try the free green curry, but I would not pay for dishes I can watch for nothing.
objection: I can watch a free video for this. I am not sure following steps in an app is better than watching a real person cook it, and 99 baht is two plates of food.
would_change_my_mind: If I tried the free green curry and it came out clearly better than when I follow a YouTube video, I would pay the 99 baht.
